source: NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP confirmed-planet count plus AstroBis labelled scale references
exoplanetQuery: select count(pl_name) from ps where default_flag = 1

notes.exoplanets: Build-time NASA Exoplanet Archive count. The client displays the most recent deployed snapshot, not a live browser query.
notes.oortCloud: 1,000 AU and 100,000 AU are NASA scale estimates. The Oort Cloud has not been directly imaged.
notes.universeAge: 13.8 billion years is a standard cosmological reference value.
